decoded.meaning: A PATH whose ONE element is an RFC-0027 path label: the RFC-0018 escape record `00 <kind=0x16> <len=4> <u32 LE>`, 7 bytes, carrying slot index 1 at generation 2. This is the terminus-residual shape - the whole address is one hop's local part, so the minting hop replaced all of it. The label is HOST-SCOPED: these bytes mean a vertex only on the host that minted them, and mean nothing anywhere else.
decoded.note: The label VALUE is one little-endian u32 split 16/16 - index in the low half, generation in the high half (RFC-0027 4.1). Generation 0 is reserved 'no label' and never reaches the wire.
